sections.title: Acceptance Coordinator Efficiency Requirements
sections.content: Compact implementation contract with four slices: S0 binds implementation-complete receipts to candidate manifest, custody snapshot, terminal runner, projection knowledge context, and behavior-affecting environment identity; exact matches are required. S1 freezes and projects the candidate, machine-selects deterministic routes, rejects caller-provided deterministic routes, avoids semantic/Bootstrap invocation on deterministic-only paths, and preserves degraded context refresh behavior. S2 makes identical finalization and receipt/import replays immutable successes, creates successor attempts for stale actions, and uses a latest-successor pointer for deterministic recovery. S3 defines a one-shot, reentrant, idempotent run-coordinator that resolves targets, validates handoff, consumes bundle context, follows the action DAG, recovers stale actions, finalizes, replays validation, records telemetry, and emits typed Bootstrap handoffs for semantic routes. Non-goals include background supervision, Bootstrap from deterministic-only acceptance, Knowledge publication by Acceptance, lifecycle ownership changes, phase/runtime/workspace changes, and rewriting historical evidence.
